About

Dr. Arun Sharma

Not in the Frame is a project about the people behind the news—the reporters, camera operators, drivers and crews whose work brings stories to our screens, but whose own stories often remain unseen.

Beyond the headlines and the images we watch, there are journeys, experiences, challenges and human stories that rarely make it into the frame.

The book is currently in progress, beginning with conversations with the people who have been there—behind the camera, behind the scenes, and beyond what we see on screen.
